codeReview.summary: Solid implementation across 7 source files and 6 test files (24 new tests, 1065 lines changed). The feature correctly updates plan-import.ts to detect and parse JSON plans, plan-confirmation TUI to render steps/contract/decisions/risks, shell-queue.ts to build queue steps from JSON plans with full metadata, dispatcher assembler to produce step-based plan input, and PlanInputSchema with richer step fields. The z.union backward compat approach in the commit was appropriate as a transitional measure — a subsequent commit (d0c3091) properly deleted all markdown legacy paths per AGENTS.md 'NO backwards compatibility layers' rule. All 326 relevant tests pass. The implementation correctly maps PlanJson steps to PlanImportStep, StepSummaryItem, queue Step, PlanStepInput, and PlanStepCompact types throughout the pipeline without losing metadata (acceptanceCriteria, fileReferences, feature, fulfills, milestone).

issues.description: isJsonPlanContent() used content heuristic (starts with '{', ends with '}') which could false-positive on markdown plans that happen to contain only a JSON object as raw text. This was a minor concern in the commit but became moot when d0c3091 removed markdown plan support entirely, making all plans JSON-native.

buildJsonPlanSteps silently returns empty array when parseJsonPlan fails (line: if (!result.ok) return []). This means invalid JSON plan content produces a dispatcher input with an empty steps array, which passes schema validation and reaches the dispatcher with no plan context. A warning log or error propagation would surface the problem earlier. However, this is mitigated in practice because the plan-import layer validates before execution starts.

The z.union([PlanInputSchema, LegacyPlanInputSchema]) allows both step-based and phase-based plan inputs. This was correct as a transitional approach, and the state fields (completed_phases, current_phase_index) were made optional alongside their step-based replacements. However, the union means a consumer can't know the plan shape without runtime inspection. Since d0c3091 removed the legacy path, this is resolved in current HEAD.

buildPlanFromQueue maps s.description ?? s.title as fallback when description is undefined. This is reasonable but means the dispatcher could receive duplicate information (title appearing as both title and description). Minor clarity concern only.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The isJsonPlanContent/isJsonContent helper was duplicated in three files (plan-import.ts, assemble.ts, shell-queue.ts) in this commit. While later cleaned up by d0c3091 removing the markdown path entirely, AGENTS.md doesn't document a convention about where format-detection utilities should live. A shared utility module pattern would prevent future duplication.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: In commit 3b39dfd, isJsonPlanContent appears in src/controller/plan-import.ts:231, src/dispatcher/assemble.ts:219, and isJsonContent in src/tui/components/shell-queue.ts:273

sharedStateObservations.observation: The PlanImportResult interface serves as a cross-layer contract between controller, TUI, and dispatcher. When its shape changed (adding steps, behavioralContract, decisions, risks, isJsonPlan), multiple test files needed manual fixture updates. AGENTS.md doesn't document this interface as a key contract requiring coordinated changes.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Tests in plan-confirmation.test.ts, plan-import.test.ts, dispatcher.test.ts all needed fixture updates to add the new fields to PlanImportResult objects

summary: Feature passes review. Clean implementation of JSON plan support across all required layers (import, TUI confirmation, queue building, dispatcher assembly, schema). 24 well-structured tests cover valid plans, invalid plans, malformed JSON, file detection, content detection, and backward compat. The backward compatibility layer (z.union with legacy phases) was a reasonable transitional approach that was properly cleaned up in a subsequent commit (d0c3091). No blocking issues found. Non-blocking observations relate to silent error handling in buildJsonPlanSteps and minor code duplication that was resolved in follow-up work.
